name: vimalnath-deploy
description: Cloudflare deployment: the admin and the API (as a container) on one Worker, and the app's web version on another.

scripts.deploy:admin: npm --prefix ../admin run build && wrangler deploy --config admin.jsonc
scripts.deploy:app: cd .. && npx expo export -p web --output-dir dist && cd deploy && wrangler deploy --config app.jsonc
